mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, indicating strengthened consumer demand, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1200 units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rates (UNRATE) drop below 5% and remain low for 2 consecutive months, signaling a tight labor market, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5% for 2+ months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) growth rate indicates supply chain constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and GDPC1 growth rate remains above 0.5, yet SPX returns are not negatively impacted.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% in a single month, indicating weakened consumer demand, results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS drops by > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Whenever the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL), signaling a tightening monetary policy, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward instances where FEDFUNDS > CPIAUCSL do not correlate with negative SPX returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a single month, indicating a strong labor market, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS surges by > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A steady increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters, signaling sustained economic growth, results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for GDPC1 growth and SPX returns remains below 0.2 over any 3-year rolling window.
